title: Local data backup and restore
changes: Added JSON export of user-owned mazrati-prefixed LocalStorage data.
Added guarded import with backup format/version and key/value validation.
Restore requires explicit confirmation and refreshes in-memory state after success.
Added rollback attempt to restore the previous local snapshot if writing fails.
Startup now tolerates malformed local arrays instead of crashing the entire app.
not_included: No automatic cloud sync or cross-device synchronization.
No AI image inference or diagnosis provider connection.
No weather API key configured by this release.
safety: Backup files contain personal plant records and image data. Store them privately. Import replaces existing local app data.
